caption: The drawing depicts a single male figure standing on a rectangular brown platform. The man is dressed in traditional Middle Eastern or Ottoman attire, consisting of a large, earth-toned turban with a green accent, a long dark red and gold coat with a vertically striped yellow inner lining, loose-fitting red trousers gathered at the ankles, and black knee-high boots. He wears a light blue shirt under his coat with gold and red trim and a wide, light green cummerbund around his waist. His right arm is bent at the elbow, and his hand is raised with the fingers touching, while his left arm is extended outward with the palm facing slightly upwards. The figure has a mustache and goatee, dark hair, and a stern facial expression. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white. There is a small, thin support extending from the platform to the figure’s right leg, and the artist's signature, "CHILE-MARINOS," is visible near the bottom right of the image.
title: Cigar Store Figure
